source: Tool outputs on the trace rebuilt from the archived replay. No match record for this game (not parsed by OpenDota), so the lane itself is not known to lane_report — only the deaths before 10:00 are.

must_hit.says: Five of the twelve deaths came before 10:00 (1:51, 2:54, 4:34, 5:53, 6:38), three of them to Dark Seer. Luna finished with the most deaths on the team (12; allies 11, 8, 8, 7) in a game lost in 30:25.
After the lane it went on: at 15:35, 25:24, 28:52 and 30:06 Luna died with no ally within 2200 (six of the twelve deaths in all), and after ten of the twelve no enemy died within 15 s.
